# unifi_radius_profiles (Data Source)

Lists RADIUS profiles on a site via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`). Read-only. Named distinctly from the internal `unifi_radius_profile` resource. Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List RADIUS profiles on the site via the Official API (read-only).
# Named distinctly from the internal unifi_radius_profile resource.
data "unifi_radius_profiles" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter` (String) An optional Official-API filter expression applied server-side when listing RADIUS profiles.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site to query. If not specified, the provider's default site is used.

### Read-Only

- `profiles` (Attributes List) The RADIUS profiles defined on the site. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--profiles))

<a id="nestedatt--profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `profiles`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The UUID of the RADIUS profile.
- `metadata_origin` (String) The origin of the RADIUS profile entity (e.g. `USER_DEFINED`, `DERIVED`).
- `name` (String) The RADIUS profile name.
